summary: Ansible 14 deprecations: netapp.cloudmanager and cyberark.pas will be removed from Ansible 15, and community.mysql has become redirects to ansible.mysql, with full removal in Ansible 17.

answer_card.title: Collection deprecations in Ansible 14
answer_card.answer_md:
- **netapp.cloudmanager:** unmaintained; removed from Ansible 15 unless a maintainer steps up.
- **community.mysql:** renamed to `ansible.mysql`; its content became deprecated redirects in Ansible 14.0.0 and it is removed entirely in **Ansible 17**. Update FQCNs.
- **cyberark.pas:** removed from Ansible 15 for repeated inclusion requirement violations.

Removed collections can still be installed with `ansible-galaxy collection install <name>`.
